Skills.Name: Hospitality
Skills.Description: The sworn host's discipline. Not for sale: a Tent-Right host administers the oath to someone the camps trust, and an oathbreaker loses it for good.

Powers.Name: Extend the Cloth
Powers.Description: Name an adjacent person guest for three days. No person may harm them, they keep the peace, and you must not strike them. Someone who wants you dead takes the cloth only when beaten (below half health). 30-turn cooldown.
